updater.$comment: The endpoint is what `includeUpdaterJson` in .github/workflows/release.yml publishes. `pubkey` is the public half of a key pair from `pnpm tauri signer generate`; the private half belongs in the repository's secrets and nowhere else. An empty pubkey means the app checks, finds a manifest it cannot verify, and refuses the update - which is the correct behaviour rather than a bug.

cli.longDescription: Play, pause and skip from a script or a shortcut. With no arguments the window opens normally; with a transport argument the running instance is told what to do and no second window appears.

args.name: toggle
args.description: Play if paused, pause if playing

args.name: stop
args.description: Stop playback and clear what is playing

args.name: open
args.description: Play an audio file, or add it to the queue
